ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising_edge reference for all clocked processes in this entity; sequences updates of control, TX/RX engines, IRQ outputs and UART RTS. It also drives instantiated FIFOs via their clock ports.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in processes bus_access, transmitter, receiver, fifo_overrun, rtr_control, tx_irq_generator, rx_irq_generator and sim_tx; clk_i also port-mapped to FIFOs

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asynchronous reset that forces registers to defined values in each clocked process; clears control and engine state on reset and is passed to instantiated FIFOs.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in clocked processes: bus_access, transmitter, receiver, fifo_overrun, rtr_control, tx_irq_generator, rx_irq_generator

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Encapsulates the bus transaction inputs; its fields are used to write control registers, provide TX data, and select read responses, and to gate bus access behaviour.
ports.evidence: record used in bus_access process and in other concurrent guards; fields are referenced in code

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Carries the transaction address bits; bit 2 is tested to select between control registers and data FIFO accesses and thus chooses which assignments occur on bus accesses.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then ... else ... in bus_access and used in concurrent tx_fifo.we/rx_fifo.re expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies 32-bit write data for bus writes; individual bits/slices drive control register fields and provide transmit FIFO write data when a write to the data register occurs.
ports.evidence: bus_access write path assigns ctrl fields from bus_req_i.data slices; tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request bundle but not referenced elsewhere in this source; carries byte-enable information from the bus if used externally.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.ben in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates an active bus transfer; it gates bus-access handling (read/write branching), directly drives bus_rsp_o.ack, and enables FIFO read/write actions for data transfers.
ports.evidence: bus_access: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ...; bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re conditions include bus_req_i.stb

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects read or write bus-access paths; it chooses whether control registers are written or read and whether FIFOs are read from or written to.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then (write path) else (read path) in bus_access; used in FIFO enable expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared field in the bus request record but not referenced in this source file; would identify request origin if used externally.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.src in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this entity; carries privilege information in the bus request if used by surrounding logic.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.priv in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but unused in this file; part of bus_req_t bundle.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.debug in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Present in the bus request record but not used here.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.amo in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared but unused in this entity; part of the bus request record.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.amoop in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not referenced here.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.lock in this source

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but unused in this file; part of the bus request bundle.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.fence in this source

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Aggregates response fields that this entity drives back to the bus; fields ack, err and data are updated in bus_access and exported to the bus master.
ports.evidence: bus_access process assigns bus_rsp_o as a record and later assigns its fields

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Captured each cycle from the incoming bus strobe; acknowledges the bus transaction by latching bus_req_i.stb into the response ack bit.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb in bus_access process (rising_edge clk_i)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Holds the error indicator for the bus response; this entity drives it to '0' each cycle (no error reported here).
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in bus_access process (rising_edge clk_i); reset also sets bus_rsp_o <= rsp_terminate_c

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Delivers readback data for bus reads; various control bits, FIFO status and data bytes are written into slices of this vector in bus_access.
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns various bus_rsp_o.data bit-slices from ctrl fields, rx_fifo.*, tx_fifo.*, rx_engine.over and tx_engine.busy

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Drives an external clock generator enable directly from the control enable bit; reports the internal enable state to the clock generator domain.
ports.evidence: clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable (concurrent assignment)

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Supplies multiple clock phases or sources; one bit is selected by ctrl.prsc and assigned to uart_clk to pace UART bit timing.
ports.evidence: uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) (concurrent assignment)

ports.name: uart_txd_o
ports.functionality: Outputs the current transmit serial bit driven from the transmitter engine's txd register; reflects internal tx_engine.txd to the pin.
ports.evidence: uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd (concurrent assignment)

ports.name: uart_rxd_i
ports.functionality: Provides the serial RX bit into the RX engine; sampled into rx_engine.sync and used to shift received bits into the RX shift register.
ports.evidence: rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i in receiver process (rising_edge clk_i)

ports.name: uart_rtsn_o
ports.function: RTS (request to send) output, active low
ports.functionality: Implements hardware flow-control RTS by driving the line based on hwfc_en, enable and RX FIFO fill level; updated synchronously in rtr_control process.
role: driven by RX fill and hwfc enable
ports.evidence: rtr_control process: if ctrl.hwfc_en = '1' then if ctrl.enable='0' or rx_fifo.half='1' then uart_rtsn_o <= '1' else '0' end if

ports.name: uart_ctsn_i
ports.function: CTS (clear to send) input, active low
ports.functionality: Provides remote hardware-flow-control status into the transmitter engine; sampled each cycle and shifted into tx_engine.cts to decide whether to progress transmission.
ports.evidence: tx_engine.cts <= tx_engine.cts(0) & uart_ctsn_i in transmitter process (rising_edge clk_i)

ports.name: irq_rx_o
ports.functionality: Generates the receive interrupt by combining ctrl.enable with configured IRQ conditions (RX non-empty, half, full) and current RX FIFO status signals; value computed each clock cycle.
ports.evidence: rx_irq_generator process assigns irq_rx_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_nempty and rx_fifo.avail) or (ctrl.irq_rx_half and rx_fifo.half) or (ctrl.irq_rx_full and (not rx_fifo.free)))

ports.name: irq_tx_o
ports.functionality: Generates the transmit interrupt by combining ctrl.enable with configured TX IRQ conditions and current TX FIFO status; updated in a clocked process each cycle.
ports.evidence: tx_irq_generator process assigns irq_tx_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_tx_empty and (not tx_fifo.avail)) or (ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf and (not tx_fifo.half)))

signals.name: uart_clk
signals.functionality: Carries a single clock bit selected from clkgen_i using the prescaler index ctrl.prsc; used by RX/TX engines as UART timing reference.
signals.evidence: uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds UART configuration and IRQ enable/clear bits; individual fields are loaded from bus_req_i.data on bus writes and read back on bus reads.
signals.evidence: bus_access process assigns multiple ctrl fields from bus_req_i.data in write path

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Stores whether the UART is enabled; loaded from bus writes and used to enable clockgen output, start/stop TX and RX engines and to reset FIFO clears when disabled.
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in bus_access; ctrl.enable used for tx_engine.state(2) and rx_engine.state(1); clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable

signals.name: ctrl.sim_mode
signals.functionality: Records whether simulation transmit logging is active; loaded from bus writes and used to force FIFO clears and to enable simulation transmitter behaviour.
signals.evidence: ctrl.sim_mode <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_sim_en_c) and bool_to_ulogic_f(sim_mode_en_c); used in tx_fifo.clear and rx_fifo.clear

signals.name: ctrl.hwfc_en
signals.functionality: Enables RTS/CTS hardware flow control; loaded from bus writes and used to gate RTS generation and to require CTS low before transmitting.
signals.evidence: ctrl.hwfc_en <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_hwfc_en_c) in bus_access; used in rtr_control and (ctrl.hwfc_en = '0') check in transmitter

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Stores the index selecting which clkgen_i bit is used as uart_clk; loaded from bus writes and used to index clkgen_i for uart timing.
signals.evidence: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c); uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl.baud
signals.functionality: Holds the baud reload counter value; loaded from bus writes and used to initialize/reload transmitter and receiver baud counters.
signals.evidence: ctrl.baud <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_baud9_c downto ctrl_baud0_c); used in transmitter/receiver to set baudcnt

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_nempty
signals.functionality: Enables RX non-empty interrupt when set; loaded from bus writes and read back via bus_rsp_o.data.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_nempty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_nempty_c); used in rx_irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_half
signals.functionality: Enables RX half-available interrupt; loaded from bus writes and used in the RX IRQ generation logic and readback.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_half <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_half_c); used in rx_irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_full
signals.functionality: Enables RX full interrupt; set by bus writes and used to assert RX IRQ when FIFO is full.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_full <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_full_c); used in rx_irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.functionality: Enables TX empty interrupt; loaded from bus writes and combined with TX FIFO empty status to produce irq_tx_o.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_empty_c); used in tx_irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.functionality: Enables TX near-half interrupt; set by bus writes and used with tx_fifo.half to generate irq_tx_o.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_nhalf_c); used in tx_irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl.clr_rx
signals.functionality: Latched clear command for RX FIFO set by a bus write; auto-cleared each cycle and used in the rx_fifo.clear concurrent assignment to force FIFO clear.
signals.evidence: ctrl.clr_rx <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_rx_clr_c); rx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable='0') or (ctrl.sim_mode='1') or (ctrl.clr_rx='1') else '0'

signals.name: ctrl.clr_tx
signals.functionality: Latched clear command for TX FIFO set by bus write; auto-cleared each cycle and used in tx_fifo.clear concurrent assignment to force FIFO clear.
signals.evidence: ctrl.clr_tx <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_tx_clr_c); tx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable='0') or (ctrl.sim_mode='1') or (ctrl.clr_tx='1') else '0'

signals.name: tx_engine
signals.functionality: Record holding the transmitter FSM state, shift register, counters, CTS history and status bits; updated in the transmitter process and drives uart_txd_o via tx_engine.txd.
signals.evidence: transmitter process assigns fields of tx_engine; uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd

signals.name: tx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Holds the TX FSM state bits controlling transmission phases; updated in the transmitter process and used to generate FIFO read requests and the busy flag.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable; case tx_engine.state is ...; tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (tx_engine.state = "100")

signals.name: tx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Loads a data byte (plus stop bit) from tx_fifo.rdata and shifts out bits during transmission; updated in transmitter process and feeds tx_engine.txd.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0' when starting; later shifted: tx_engine.sreg <= '1' & tx_engine.sreg(tx_engine.sreg'left downto 1)

signals.name: tx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts bits remaining to transmit; initialized in the transmitter and decremented during bit output to determine end-of-byte and set tx_engine.done.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.bitcnt <= "1011" in '100' branch; decremented when baudcnt expires in '111' branch

signals.name: tx_engine.baudcnt
signals.functionality: Holds the current baud countdown value for the transmitter; reloaded from ctrl.baud and decremented each uart_clk cycle to time bit shifts.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.baudcnt <= ctrl.baud on start; if tx_engine.baudcnt = "0000000000" then reload to ctrl.baud and shift sreg

signals.name: tx_engine.done
signals.functionality: Pulses when a byte transmission completes; set in the transmitter FSM when bitcnt reaches zero, used to indicate completion and for other logic.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.done <= '1' when tx_engine.bitcnt = "0000" in transmitter; tx_engine.done cleared each cycle at start of transmitter

signals.name: tx_engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinationally indicates whether the transmitter FSM is active; derived from the low two FSM state bits and used in bus readback.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.busy <= '0' when (tx_engine.state(1 downto 0) = "00") else '1'; bus_rsp_o.data(... ctrl_tx_busy_c ...) <= tx_engine.busy or tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: tx_engine.cts
signals.functionality: Shifts in uart_ctsn_i each cycle to provide a small history/sample of CTS; used to decide if remote allows sending.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.cts <= tx_engine.cts(0) & uart_ctsn_i in transmitter process; used in condition checking tx_engine.cts(1)

signals.name: tx_engine.txd
signals.functionality: Holds the bit to output on UART TX; set inside transmitter process from the LSB of the shift register and provided to the external pin via uart_txd_o.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.txd <= tx_engine.sreg(0) in '111' branch; uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd

signals.name: rx_engine
signals.functionality: Record holding the RX FSM state, shift register, counters, sync samples, done flag and overrun indicator; updated in receiver process and fifo_overrun.
signals.evidence: receiver process assigns rx_engine fields; fifo_overrun assigns rx_engine.over

signals.name: rx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Contains RX state bits controlling sampling and bit collection; updated in receiver process and used internally to move between idle, start and data-collect states.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.state(1) <= ctrl.enable; case rx_engine.state is ... in receiver process

signals.name: rx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Shifts synchronized RX samples into a byte-wide register during reception; the low 8 bits are offered to rx_fifo.wdata on rx_engine.done.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0); rx_engine.sreg <= rx_engine.sync(2) & rx_engine.sreg(rx_engine.sreg'left downto 1)

signals.name: rx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts remaining bits to sample for an incoming byte; initialized and decremented in receiver FSM to determine when a byte is complete.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.bitcnt <= "1010" on start; decremented when baudcnt expires

signals.name: rx_engine.baudcnt
signals.functionality: Holds the current receive baud countdown; reloaded from ctrl.baud (with a shift) and decremented on uart_clk to time sampling points.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.baudcnt <= '0' & ctrl.baud(9 downto 1) on start; decremented when uart_clk = '1'

signals.name: rx_engine.done
signals.functionality: Pulses when a full byte has been received; set in the receiver FSM when bitcnt reaches zero and used to write into rx_fifo.we.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.done <= '1' when rx_engine.bitcnt = "0000"; rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done

signals.name: rx_engine.sync
signals.functionality: Three-stage synchroniser/sample of the asynchronous UART RX pin to produce stable samples used by the RX FSM; sampled from uart_rxd_i and shifted on uart_clk.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i; if (uart_clk = '1') then rx_engine.sync(1 downto 0) <= rx_engine.sync(2 downto 1)

signals.name: rx_engine.over
signals.functionality: Records if an incoming byte was lost due to RX FIFO being full; set when a FIFO write occurs while free='0' and cleared when UART disabled or on reset.
signals.evidence: fifo_overrun process: if (rx_fifo.we = '1') and (rx_fifo.free = '0') then rx_engine.over <= '1'; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_rx_over_c) <= rx_engine.over

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.functionality: Collection of RX FIFO control/status/data signals; some fields are driven by the instantiated FIFO entity and others are driven locally (clear, we, re, wdata).
signals.evidence: rx_engine and rx_fifo port map to neorv32_fifo instance; rx_fifo fields assigned/used in concurrent statements

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combines enable, sim_mode and clr_rx to generate the FIFO clear input for the RX FIFO instance; asserted when UART disabled, in simulation mode, or when clear bit is set.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.sim_mode = '1') or (ctrl.clr_rx = '1') else '0'

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Asserted when the RX engine signals a completed received byte; wired directly from rx_engine.done to request FIFO write.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Generated when the bus performs a read to the data register; computed from bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw and bus_req_i.addr(2).
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the received byte to the RX FIFO; driven from the low 8 bits of rx_engine.sreg.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0) (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Data presented by the RX FIFO instance when read; used to supply bus readback of received byte slices.
signals.evidence: bus_access read path: bus_rsp_o.data(data_rtx_msb_c downto data_rtx_lsb_c) <= rx_fifo.rdata

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Indicates whether the RX FIFO has free space (from instantiated FIFO); used to determine full status and overrun conditions and to form bus readback bits.
signals.evidence: bus_access uses not rx_fifo.free for ctrl_rx_full; fifo_overrun tests rx_fifo.free in overrun condition

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Indicates that RX FIFO has data available (non-empty); used in IRQ generation and in bus readback of status bits.
signals.evidence: bus_access reads rx_fifo.avail into bus_rsp_o.data; rx_irq_generator uses rx_fifo.avail

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Indicates RX FIFO has reached half-full threshold; used for HW RTS control, IRQ generation and bus readback.
signals.evidence: bus_access reads rx_fifo.half; rx_irq_generator uses rx_fifo.half; rtr_control checks rx_fifo.half for RTS

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.functionality: Collection of TX FIFO control/status/data signals; some fields driven by the instantiated FIFO entity (free, rdata, avail, half) while control fields (clear, wdata, we, re) are driven locally.
signals.evidence: tx_engine_fifo_inst port map and concurrent assignments to tx_fifo fields

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combines ctrl.enable, ctrl.sim_mode and ctrl.clr_tx to create clear input for TX FIFO; asserted when UART disabled, in simulation mode, or when clear bit set.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.sim_mode = '1') or (ctrl.clr_tx = '1') else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Asserted to write a byte into the TX FIFO on a bus write to the data register; derived from bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw and bus_req_i.addr(2).
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Requests a read from the TX FIFO when the transmitter FSM enters the read state (state = "100"); generated from the transmitter state comparison.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (tx_engine.state = "100") else '0'; tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0' when starting

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the byte to be written into the TX FIFO from the bus write data low 8 bits; supplied directly from bus_req_i.data slice.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(data_rtx_msb_c downto data_rtx_lsb_c)

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Byte presented by TX FIFO when read; loaded into tx_engine.sreg when the transmitter starts a transmission.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0' in transmitter when entering send state

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Indicates whether the TX FIFO has free space; provided by FIFO instance and read back to the bus and used to form tx busy indication.
signals.evidence: bus_access uses not tx_fifo.free for ctrl_tx_full; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_busy_c) <= tx_engine.busy or tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Indicates TX FIFO contains entries (available to read); provided by FIFO instance and used for IRQ generation and bus readback.
signals.evidence: bus_access reads not tx_fifo.avail for tx_empty status; tx_irq_generator uses tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Indicates TX FIFO level reached a half threshold; provided by FIFO instance and used for IRQ generation and bus readback.
signals.evidence: bus_access reads not tx_fifo.half for tx_nhalf status; tx_irq_generator uses tx_fifo.half
